title: German champions in the Bundesliga | World Football FAQ
content: Bayern Munich have won the Bundesliga in 34 out of 63 seasons, while Bayer Leverkusen became the 13th different club to be crowned champions of Germany since the Bundesliga began as the country’s nationwide championship in 1963. Borussia Dortmund, Werder Bremen, Hamburg, VfB Stuttgart, Cologne and Kaiserslautern have all lifted the Meisterschale multiple times. Champions with 45 points ahead of Meiderich in second (39 points). Uwe Seeler (Hamburg) was the league's top scorer with 30 goals. Rudolf Brunnenmeier (1860 Munich) was the league's top scorer with 24 goals. Champions with 50 points (league expanded from 16 to 18 teams) ahead of Borussia Dortmund in second (47 points). Lothar Emmerich (Borussia Dortmund) was the league's top scorer with 31 goals. Champions with 43 points ahead of 1860 Munich in second (41 points). Gerd Müller (Bayern Munich) and Lothar Emmerich (Borussia Dortmund) were the league's top scorers with 28 goals. Gerd Müller (Bayern Munich) was the league's top scorer with 38 goals.
